description:
We are TagEdu, an education & tech team passionate about open science, data visualization, and space exploration. We bring strong expertise in software development, data analysis, and UI/UX design to build impactful solutions.

Looking for: Enthusiastic teammates with skills in scientific research, storytelling/pitching, or 3D/graphic design. Let’s collaborate and build something amazing!
summary:
We developed Zero-G Academy, an interactive, space-themed educational web application. The platform integrates multi-planet gravity physics simulations—such as the Gravity Drop and Black Hole Lab—with diagnostic assessments, embedded video lessons, and a custom AI teacher persona named Laika, powered by Gemini 1.5-flash.

This project addresses the challenge of student disengagement in STEM by transforming passive science instruction into active, gamified exploration. Instead of simply reading about physics, students directly manipulate variables within real-time simulations. When they require assistance, Laika provides strict, domain-specific guidance, configured to offer concise, three-to-five sentence hints rather than giving away direct answers.

Zero-G Academy is important because it modernizes astrophysics education, making complex space mechanics accessible and highly engaging. By combining interactive UI design, reliable web architecture, and tightly steered AI, the platform empowers students to safely experiment with cosmic physics and provides a scalable blueprint for the future of interactive digital classrooms.
details:
Project Overview & Functionality Zero-G Academy is an interactive, space-themed educational web application that gamifies astrophysics and STEM learning. The platform operates through a dynamic frontend dashboard featuring a tiered lesson tree (such as the "Deep Cosmos Exploration" category). As students progress through the nodes, they unlock diagnostic assessments, embedded video lessons, and interactive multi-planet gravity physics simulations like the "Gravity Drop," "Mars Rover," and "Black Hole Lab." The core functionality is powered by a Node.js backend that handles routing and dynamically generates the user interface from JavaScript data arrays, connecting the main hub to deeply nested simulation environments.

Benefits to Users The platform transforms passive science instruction into active experimentation. Instead of reading static textbook equations, students can visually manipulate physical variables within real-time space simulations to immediately see the effects of gravity and mass. Furthermore, the application prevents passive learning and easy cheating through the integration of an AI teacher persona, "Laika." Laika is strictly configured to provide targeted, 3-5 sentence conceptual hints rather than direct answers, forcing students to engage in critical thinking to solve physics problems.

Intended Impact The primary goal is to address the widespread challenge of student disengagement in STEM fields. By lowering the barrier to entry for complex astrophysics mechanics and presenting them in a highly engaging, video-game-style interface, Zero-G Academy aims to modernize digital classrooms. It serves as a scalable blueprint for how schools can integrate interactive UI design and strictly steered AI to safely guide students through complex scientific exploration.
